title: ‘Agni-4’ Ballistic Missile successfully test-fired
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Defence

‘Agni-4’ Ballistic Missile successfully test-fired

Posted On:
06 AUG 2026 7:01PM by PIB Delhi

Medium Range Ballistic Missile ‘Agni-4’ was successfully test-fired from the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur in Odisha on August 06, 2026. The launch validated all operational and technical parameters. The test was carried out under the aegis of the Strategic Forces Command.

***
